## Change

What does this improve, and which issue does it address?

## Verification

List the tests, production builds and actual runtime/browser checks performed. Note skipped or manual checks explicitly.

## Compatibility and recovery

Describe data, API, migration, permissions, dependency, locale and release-artifact implications. Explain rollback or recovery if relevant.

- [ ] New behavior has regression coverage and no new lint warnings.
- [ ] Relevant hosted, standalone, extension and server paths were checked.
- [ ] Documentation, translations and release downloads are consistent with the change.
- [ ] The diff and attachments contain no credentials, investigation data, private plans, profiles or unreviewed logs.
- [ ] No push, deployment, provider request or repository-setting change is implied by these test results.
